method: Scoped source-to-vector visual and H4/H6/H8 expert review; not a new full H1-H10 execution.

observations.observation: Same mark used in navigation, sign-in and favicon; original charcoal and light-on-black variants share identical geometry.
Full text name and accessible navigation label remain unchanged; icon does not replace a label.

Nine nodes use a uniform radius of 2.5; upper yellow and orange endpoint centres are 8 units apart with a 3-unit edge gap. Separate paths have no bridging stroke. No reflow failures in inspected screens.

limitations: Manual vector reconstruction from the supplied 100px JPEG, not an original vector master or pixel-identical tracing.
Asset-only design revision. No backend, live authentication, recording, AI, research or deployment.
27 responsive observations cover three screens at three actual CSS widths for each candidate; the full state/interaction suite was not rerun.
No representative-user or complete accessibility/security/performance claim. Screenshots inspected inline through CUA; no exported raster capture claimed.
